representative_scale.selection_reason: Published test expects holo/apo/predicted configurations for this exact case. Fixed actual protein docking calibration, no scale search or extrapolation to all 93.
representative_scale.larger_study_scope: Prioritize all 93 paired-apo cases in subsequent preregistered study; AAV redocking separate.

inputs.required: Released index/metadata and primary apo receptor/ligand plus native holo target and mappings for fixed ID; FroDock soap.bin from pinned mirror.
inputs.configuration_status: Local fixed-scale plan; not a published measured run. Concrete preprocessing output paths and seed protocol unresolved.

outputs.score_interface: pinder_eval reads method/complex/apo_decoys ranked PDBs; emits DockQ, iRMS, LRMS, Fnat and ranks. Compute direct DockQ >= 0.23 success separately from published CAPRI leaderboard.
reports: maximum DockQ among fixed five poses
number and time of evaluated candidates
time to acceptable pose if observable
cost only with established compute price

timing_scope.setup: Acquisition/install/compile and input preparation reported separately, not docking speed.
timing_scope.baseline_run: End-to-end maps, docking search, clustering and pose generation for fixed apo pair; include synchronization and CPU/GPU work.
timing_scope.evaluation: Native-target scoring separately timed; include in time-to-acceptable if quality requires oracle evaluation.
timing_scope.first_acceptable_limit: Published adapter exposes final poses, not candidate arrival times; time-to-first-acceptable may be unavailable rather than inferred from rank.
timing_scope.repeats_reason: No seed list or repeat count established. Timing requires measurement, no claimed budget guarantee.

budget_basis: Planning caps; method_run raised for real single-case calibration. No workload run; cannot establish completion time. Abort over-budget runs without changing fixed scale.

execution_readiness.status: requires source repairs and resolved environment
execution_readiness.reason: Known adapter/build issues documented in benchmark.json. No builds or workloads authorized during intake.
execution_readiness.gate_scripts_reason: Prompt names no gate script paths or commands; validate JSON structure and required keys locally.
